This was the second professional season in the history of the country. [[Al-Ahli (UAE)|Ahli Dubai]] were defending champions from the 2008–09 campaign. [[Al Khaleej Club|Al Khaleej]] and [[Al-Shaab sport club, Sharjah|Al-Shaab]] were relegated from the previous season. [[Bani Yas Club]] and [[Emirates Club]] were promoted from the [[UAE Second Division]].
